sources.entry: huey - A little task queue with multi-process, multi-thread, or greenlet workers.

summary.one_liner: huey is a lightweight Python task queue with multi-process, multi-thread, and greenlet workers, plus scheduling, retries, and periodic tasks.
summary.what_it_does: Huey lets you decorate Python functions with @task so calls are enqueued and run by a separate consumer process, returning a result handle to fetch the output later. It supports delayed and scheduled execution, crontab-style recurring tasks, automatic retries with delay, and task priorities, expiration, locking, rate limits, and timeouts. Workers can run as processes, threads, or greenlets, selected with the huey_consumer command's -k option. Task pipelines, chains, groups (fan-out), and chords (map/reduce) are also supported. Storage backends include Redis (and Valkey/Redict), Postgres, SQLite, file-system, and in-memory, and it has Django integration with optional admin pages.
use_cases: run background jobs in a Python web app
schedule tasks to run after a delay or at a set time
replace cron-style recurring jobs with in-app periodic tasks
retry flaky network or API calls automatically
fan-out work across workers with groups or map/reduce chords
queue tasks in Django with admin visibility
how_to_run: from huey import RedisHuey; huey = RedisHuey('my-app', host='redis.myapp.com')
Decorate functions with @huey.task() and call them to enqueue
notable: Zero dependencies beyond the driver for the chosen storage backend
Multiple storage backends: Redis, Postgres, SQLite, file-system, in-memory
Process, thread, and greenlet worker models selectable on the consumer
Native Django integration and django.tasks support with admin
Supports groups, chords, pipelines, and chains
caveats: Redis-like brokers need the redis-py package; Postgres needs psycopg
Full feature guide and examples live in external documentation rather than the README
Django admin integration is optional and requires Django
keywords: schedule python function to run later
